## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the Developer Certificate of Origin, by its author.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run mypy src` and the tests pass.
- [ ] A fixed defect has a regression test.
- [ ] A new dependency is registered and its licence is compatible with Apache-2.0.
- [ ] No real research, credentials or personal paths are included.
